The '''Birch Bench''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|750}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}. It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

Players who select a [[Farm Maps|Beach farm map]] during character creation will have one inside their [[Farmhouse]] when the game begins. Players who select a [[Farm Maps|Four Corners farm map]] during character creation will have two inside their [[Farmhouse]] when the game begins.
